headline: Approved Director Bagley to complete H.U.D. application for $1,200,000 grant for resource center funding, 15-0
summary: The Board of Aldermen held a special meeting to discuss a resource center. Director Bobbie Bagley presented on homelessness in Nashua, and the board voted 15-0 to let her proceed with a $1,200,000 H.U.D. grant application for resource center funding.
decisions: Approved Director Bagley to take the next step and complete the H.U.D. application for a $1,200,000 grant for resource center funding, with all 15 members voting yes.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION BY ALDERMAN KELLY FOR THE BOARD OF ALDERMEN APPROVE DIRECTOR BAGLEY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP AND COMPLETE THE H.U.D. APPLICATION FOR A $1,200,000 GRANT FOR THE PURPOSE OF RESOURCE CENTER FUNDING ... MOTION CARRIED

plain_text:
A Special Meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 7:02 pm in the 
Aldermanic Chamber and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the 
requirements of RSA 91-A:2 II. 
   
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Daniel Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Daniel Healey; Alderman Richard A. Dowd, led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.  If you are participating via Zoom, please state your 
presence, reason for not attending the meeting in person, and whether there is anyone in the room with you 
during this meeting, which is required under the Right-To-Know Law. 
 
The roll call was taken with 15 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons,  
Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman 
Gregg, Alderman Dowd, Alderman Sullivan (via Zoom), Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, 
Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, Alderman Wilshire.    
 
Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton is also in attendance. 
 
President Wilshire recognized Tim Cummings, Director of Administrative Services.   
 
President Wilshire recognized Michelle McGonagle, Human Resources Manager.  
 
COMMUNICATION REQUIRING ONLY PROCEDURAL ACTIONS AND WRITTEN REPORTS FROM 
LIAISONS 
 
From: President Lori Wilshire 
Re:  Calling Special Board of Aldermen meeting on August 25, 2026 to discuss a resource center 
 
There being no objection, President Wilshire accepted the communication and placed it on file. 
 
 
DISCUSSION AND/OR PRESENTATION 
• Resource Center 
 
President Wilshire recognized Director Bobbie Bagley. 
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN KELLY FOR THE BOARD OF ALDERMEN APPROVE DIRECTOR BAGLEY 
TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP AND COMPLETE THE H.U.D. APPLICATION FOR A $1,200,000 GRANT 
FOR THE PURPOSE OF RESOURCE CENTER FUNDING 
 
A viva voce roll call was taken, which resulted as follows: 
 
Yea: Alderman Clemons, Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith,  
 Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg, Alderman Dowd,  
 Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly,  
 Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, Alderman Wilshire       15 
 
Nay:                                                                                                                                               0  
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT
Special Board of Aldermen                                           08-25-2026                        Page 2 
 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN CLEMONS THAT THE AUGUST 25, 2026 SPECIAL MEETING OF THE 
BOARD OF ALDERMEN BE ADJOURNED, BY ROLL CALL 
 
A viva voce roll call was taken, which resulted as follows: 
 
Yea: Alderman Clemons, Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith,  
 Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg, Alderman Dowd,  
 Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly,  
 Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, Alderman Wilshire       15 
 
Nay:                                                                                             0  
 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 8:46 p.m.             
 
                Attest:  Alderman Patricia Klee
Bobbie D. Bagley & LaTonya Muccioli
